items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I played for a guy there named Harry [Eagle]

ctx.x: Mark. M-A-R-K. Mark Fisher. Well I followed his band into the 5100 Club, and this was around '39 and '40, and I played for a guy there named Harry [Eagle] who had Danny Thomas there as the star of the show. And from there, you know where Danny went.
